delta_from_prior: Replaced the 24-variable, 169-clause mixed-group bipartite fixture (neon_worstcase_auto_00128, peak 4) with a strictly smaller, faster, link-twin-free 16-variable, 150-clause lifted graph-transversal contradiction F(2 K_3, 2 K_3) compressing to 12 variables and 54 clauses, eliminating disjoint pair twins while preserving exact root compression, dual-stage core evasion, and residual branching peak >= 4. Also explicitly retracted the falsified Neon54/55 K6 near-parity claims and identified the exact 3-uniform obstruction to Fable111's AV+ proposal.
explanation:
AUDIT OF PINNED v5 (blq-composed-core-scc-emra-ialh5-v5):
1. Soundness audit: No wrong-answer bug was found across the supplied solver, compression.py, core_refutation.py, or the pinned SCC/DP/MRA dependencies. In compression._verify_certificate, every original clause is mapped into an exact-support block (rejecting duplicate variables per clause), block_clause_counts must match len(blocks) and sum to len(quotient), every quotient basis form referenced by a block must lie inside that block's support mask, local truth-table equivalence is checked exhaustively on all 2^|support| assignments per block, and P*L = I_r is checked entrywise over GF(2) to certify surjectivity. Thus original and quotient formulas are equisatisfiable. In core_refutation.probe, an independent set(core).issubset(set(f)) gate ensures no clauses are injected, and only a compressed 2-SAT UNSAT quotient can return UNSAT; in run_counting, applying probe once to the verified quotient preserves soundness by exact equivalence. In run_counting_core, refute verifies every local lattice consequence against fresh UP tables and checks the dual rational vector with Fraction arithmetic, while canon_plus, elim_plus, and prune preserve satisfiability.
2. Prior-receipt correction: Neon54/55 K6 near-parity witnesses are acknowledged as falsified (peak 0, root IALH UNSAT), because width-5 UP tables retain the XOR congruence even after deleting a satisfying point and the global integer system combines rows across windows.

FIXTURE CONSTRUCTION (LIFTED F(2 K_3, 2 K_3), 16 VARS, 150 CLAUSES):
Generalizing Neon58's bipartite pair-transversal T_k = F(k K_2, k K_2), for any graphs G_L, G_R on disjoint vertex sets, define F(G_L, G_R) with:
- negative clauses {-v : v in C} for every minimal vertex cover C of G_L (forcing at least one edge of G_L to be all-zero),
- negative clauses {-w : w in C'} for every minimal vertex cover C' of G_R (forcing at least one edge of G_R to be all-zero),
- positive cross-clauses e U f for every (e, f) in E(G_L) x E(G_R).
Because every assignment must falsify at least one edge on each side, F(G_L, G_R) is UNSAT.

Here G_L = 2 K_3 on {q1, q5, q9} U {q3, q7, q11} and G_R = 2 K_3 on {q2, q6, q10} U {q4, q8, q12}. Each triangle has 3 edges and 3 minimal vertex covers (all of size 2), giving 9 left negative clauses, 9 right negative clauses, and 36 positive cross-clauses (54 clauses of width 4 on 12 quotient variables). To test exact root compression, four quotient variables are lifted to XOR pairs: q9 = x9^x13, q10 = x10^x14, q11 = x11^x15, q12 = x12^x16, while q1..q8 = x1..x8. Expanding each positive literal +q_i into two clauses (x_i, x_{i+4}) and (-x_i, -x_{i+4}) and each negative literal -q_i into (-x_i, x_{i+4}) and (x_i, -x_{i+4}) yields 25 left negative, 25 right negative, and 100 positive clauses (150 clauses, max width 6, 16 variables).

TRACE ON PINNED v5:
1. Exact root compression (compression.compress_root): All limits pass (16 <= 64 vars, 150 <= 1024 clauses, width 6 <= 8, 2400 <= 16384 local points). The 8 lifted variables appear only in even-sized blocks (2 or 4 forbidden points), so len(frozen) = 8 < 16. Each of the 8 single-variable forms e1..e8 and the 4 XOR forms e9^e13, e10^e14, e11^e15, e12^e16 lies in exactly 18 block annihilators, whereas every other nonzero form appears in at most 9 blocks. Under compress_root's sort key (-frequency, popcount, bitmask), chosen is strictly [e1..e8, e9^e13, e10^e14, e11^e15, e12^e16], which spans every block annihilator (no greedy incompatibility). The verified quotient is exactly F(2 K_3, 2 K_3) with ascending order [1..12], interleaving one variable from each of the four triangles per round.
2. Core refutation (core_refutation.probe): On the original 150-clause input, every block's forbidden set is already a complete coset of its stabilizer (sizes 1, 2, or 4), so no translation removes any point (no_clauses_removed -> UNKNOWN). On the 54-clause quotient, every block has size 1, so quotient probing also returns no_clauses_removed -> UNKNOWN.
3. Residual search (run_counting_core):
- Root (54 clauses): No binary clauses; every width-4 and width-5 UP table includes 0 and all unit vectors (on negative windows) or all-1s and all weight-4 vectors (on positive windows), so IALH-5 derives 0 constraints. Every variable has 12 positive and 6 negative occurrences (36 non-tautological resolvents vs 18 removed), so elim_plus is STUCK.
- Layer 1 (branch on 1): 1=True shrinks L1 to pair {5,9} (39 clauses, STUCK, 0 IALH constraints). 1=False leaves 3 left negative clauses [-5,-9,-3,-7], [-5,-9,-3,-11], [-5,-9,-7,-11]; here v=3 has 12 positive and 2 negative occurrences with half tautological (12 resolvents <= 14 removed), so elim_plus eliminates 3 and stops at 40 clauses (STUCK, 0 IALH constraints). Both states are incomparable under prune -> 2 states.
- Layer 2 (branch on 2): Symmetrically splits into 4 states (T,T), (T,F), (F,T), (F,F). In (F,F), the 4 binary clauses [5,6], [5,10], [9,6], [9,10] are all-positive (no signed SCC cycles), and after eliminating 3 and 4, remaining variables have large pos*neg so elim_plus stalls. All 4 states have full-dimensional 5-var UP tables (0 IALH constraints) and are pairwise incomparable under below() -> peak >= 4 (with further splitting of (T,T) and (T,F) at Layer 3). Because the quotient has only 12 variables and 54 clauses, solver runtime stays far below timeout caps.

CHALLENGE TO FABLE'S PROPOSALS & REMAINING OBSTRUCTION:
1. Fable73's link-twin contraction fails on F(2 K_3, 2 K_3) because no two quotient variables share the same positive clause neighborhood (each triangle's edges {a,b}, {b,c}, {a,c} overlap pairwise).
2. Fable111's AV+ (additive clause vivification with UP-table emptiness on original-clause-support anchors) still refutes 2-edge graph transversals like T_k and F(2 K_3, 2 K_3) because setting one edge to 00 shrinks opposite-side cross-clauses to 2-clauses, triggering UP cascades on a single negative support. However, replacing 2-edges with 3-uniform hyperedges (e.g., T_{4,4}^{(3)}, 4 disjoint triples per side, width-6 cross-clauses, width-4 negative clauses) breaks AV+ completely: under every vivification probe c\l, opposite-side positive clauses shrink only to width-3 clauses and negative clauses remain width >= 3, so no UP cascade fires and every original-clause-support UP table stays nonempty.
3. Scope: This is a finite growth fixture (peak >= 4) demonstrating residual branching after exact compression on a link-twin-free, kernel-free input; it is not an asymptotic lower bound.
